title: Energy exchange
statementMd:
It is well known that the planet suffers from the energy crisis. Little Petya doesn't like that and wants to save the world. For this purpose he needs every accumulator to contain the same amount of energy. Initially every accumulator has some amount of energy: the $*i*$-th accumulator has $*a*_{*i*}$ units of energy. Energy can be transferred from one accumulator to the other. Every time $*x*$ units of energy are transferred ($*x*$ is not necessarily an integer) $*k*$ percent of it is lost. That is, if $*x*$ units were transferred from one accumulator to the other, amount of energy in the first one decreased by $*x*$ units and in other increased by ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5da936c833914e398476bcdcd55a9583860c2e5c.png) units.

Your task is to help Petya find what maximum equal amount of energy can be stored in each accumulator after the transfers.

## Input

First line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10000, 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 99$) — number of accumulators and the percent of energy that is lost during transfers.

Next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... , *a*_{*n*}$ — amounts of energy in the first, second, .., $*n*$-th accumulator respectively ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Output maximum possible amount of energy that can remain in each of accumulators after the transfers of energy.

The absolute or relative error in the answer should not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
众所周知，地球正遭受能源危机。小 Petya 不喜欢这样，并且想要拯救世界。为此，他需要让每个蓄电池中都含有相同数量的能量。最初，每个蓄电池中都有一定数量的能量：第 $*i*$ 个蓄电池中有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 单位的能量。能量可以从一个蓄电池转移到另一个蓄电池。每次转移 $*x*$ 单位的能量（$*x*$ 不一定是整数）时，其中的 $*k*$ 百分比会损失。也就是说，如果从一个蓄电池向另一个蓄电池转移了 $*x*$ 单位的能量，那么第一个蓄电池中的能量会减少 $*x*$ 单位，而另一个蓄电池中的能量会增加 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5da936c833914e398476bcdcd55a9583860c2e5c.png) 单位。

你的任务是帮助 Petya 求出经过能量转移后，每个蓄电池中能够储存的最大相等能量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10000, 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 99$）——蓄电池的数量，以及能量转移过程中损失的能量百分比。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... , *a*_{*n*}$——第一个、第二个、……第 $*n*$ 个蓄电池中的能量数量（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出经过能量转移后，每个蓄电池中能够剩余的最大能量。

答案的绝对误差或相对误差不应超过 $10^{ - 6}$。
